explanation: The English article on the war of 1935 begins its background with the war of 1896. Italy began its attempts to establish colonies in the Horn of Africa in the 1880s. The first phase ended with the disastrous First Italo-Ethiopian War and the defeat at Adwa on 1 March 1896. Italy then gave up its plans to take more ground in the area and limited itself to Eritrea and Somaliland for the next few decades.
